scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c auto "npm run dev -w @home-music/server" "npm run dev -w @home-music/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @home-music/shared && npm run build -w @home-music/server && npm run build -w @home-music/web
scripts.e2e:install: npm ci --prefix e2e && npm --prefix e2e run install:browsers
scripts.e2e: npm run build && npm run e2e:ci
scripts.prod:check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run smoke:production
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @home-music/shared && npm run typecheck -w @home-music/server && npm run typecheck -w @home-music/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @home-music/server && npm run test -w @home-music/web && node --test scripts/verify-production.test.mjs scripts/dependabot-policy.test.mjs
scripts.benchmark:large-library: npm run benchmark:large-library -w @home-music/server && npm run benchmark:large-library -w @home-music/web
